relevant_commits.message: feat: add distinct candidate ceiling actions
test: cover trajectory diversity and compact traces
results: add distinct candidate ceiling pilot
docs: record candidate generation ceiling verdict

key_findings: 116/L0: B, C, and D were output-equivalent by hash.
85/L0: B, C, and D were output-equivalent by hash.
113/L3: A and B were output-equivalent; C and D were output-equivalent.
The old D steps96 action changed configuration and effective-step budget but did not create distinct final candidates in the 3-case pilot.

phase_1b.scientific_question: Under oracle-sufficient offline canvas, can genuinely distinct generation trajectories produce new candidates, and can any such candidate be correct for hard true-long cases?
non_goals: Do not evaluate deployable controller quality.
Do not claim true-long infilling is solved.
Do not compare against external baselines.

action_definitions.A_primary: Current primary replay, seed 0 only, sanity use only.
action_definitions.B_route2_len32: Current Route2 len32 replay when historically triggered; otherwise primary replay, seed 0 only.
action_definitions.C_oracle_sufficient: Oracle-sufficient offline canvas with current early-commit behavior.
action_definitions.E_oracle_sufficient_no_early_commit: Same oracle-sufficient canvas as C, but disables global_gap_early_commit and records whether additional effective updates occur.
action_definitions.F_oracle_sufficient_trace_remask: Runs C, ranks suspicious positions using token flip count and final confidence from internal trace only, remasks at least one position, then runs a fixed 16-step refinement.

action_distinctness_result.interpretation: The gate passed because E/F changed the audited trajectory, even though the 85/L0 final candidate hash stayed identical to C.

SingleLineInfilling/HumanEval/113/L3.changed_mechanism: E_no_early_commit produced a distinct hash; F_trace_remask stayed hash-equivalent to C.

phase_1b.recommended_decision: Do not expand the current Route2-based generation family to 9 HumanEval cases or a full benchmark. First analyze the changed 113/L3 E candidate and the persistent 85/L0 SyntaxError, or design a stronger pre-registered candidate generator.
